title: We Cooked Crystals and the Cops Showed Up
description:
We cooked crystals. The police had questions. It was rock candy 🍬

Water near boiling holds almost five times its weight in sugar. As it cools it holds more than it should (supersaturated), so the extra sugar grows into flat-sided crystals on a string over about a week. Crack one in a really dark room and it gives off faint flashes of light (triboluminescence).

No crimes were committed. Only candy. What flavour would you make? 👇

Animated by Counterphysical. AI voices.
